# robinhood-chain-js

> The 5-lines-to-your-first-trade wrapper for Robinhood Chain. One import, sensible defaults, promise-first, browser + Node: prices, portfolios, memecoins, swaps. npm: hood-js.

robinhood-chain-js is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
